moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio e-house, written here): Target moves 0 → 100 % on cubic-bezier(.83,0,.17,1) (≈ power4.inOut, quint in-out), 600 ms: a slow wind-up, a thin fast peak in the middle, a soft landing. Site rule: the base curve against monotonous speed. Site demo: 1200 ms across 114 px beside the curve graph and a 12-frame spacing ruler (guides, not ported). Params: duration (0.6 s) · ease (custom .83,0,.17,1).
